summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] shape in ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 format entry (\x1b]0;{title}\x07) and Control.title(title), passing a single two-item code; rich/console.py adds set_window_title(title) beside show_cursor, gated only on is_terminal, returning bool; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds a SET_WINDOW_TITLE branch that calls term.set_title(title); CHANGELOG.md gets an Added heading above Fixed with a PR 2200 bullet; tests added in test_console.py, test_control.py, and test_windows_renderer.py. Tests were not run and nothing was committed, per instructions.
